items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Harry Shields directly; the mention comes from the interviewer citing Al Rose, and the interviewee responds generally about musical styles without confirming a personal connection.

ctx.x: I mean, they don't play the same song over again twice, that's for sure, but they...

On the other hand, of course, where they play things over and over, all the musicians are that way, and have been here for years, that they play everything a good deal the same way. A lot of it's sort of cut and dried, yet it doesn't sound that way, because they do put themselves into it, and a lot of enthusiasm usually, but a lot of times they'll play the same chorus, more or less, over and over again. Even the, probably original Dixieland did that on the very first records, where they recorded tunes several…
